task: Task 117 Part H — tax and Shariah information verification
method: Official/authoritative sources current at task execution time (2026-11-05). Rates were fetched, read and transcribed from the sources below — none inferred from third-party blog articles. Sources re-fetched during this task; PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries state 'last reviewed 24 August 2026' (current for tax year 2027, post-Finance-Act-2026).

schedule.appliesTo: Pakistan, tax year 2025 onward for acquisitions on/after 2024-07-01 (current law at execution time)

rules.rule: CGT — PSX listed securities acquired on/after 2024-07-01, seller on the Active Taxpayer List at BOTH acquisition and disposal
rules.legalInstrument: Income Tax Ordinance 2001, capital gains on securities regime (as amended; acquisition-vintage structure implies Finance Act 2024)
rules.officialSource: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries — Pakistan, individual income determination (reviewed 24 Aug 2026)

rules.rule: CGT — PSX listed securities acquired on/after 2024-07-01, seller NOT on the ATL (non-filer)
rules.exactRate: Normal personal slab rates apply, statutory floor 15% (rate cannot be less than 15%; rises with the individual's taxable income)
rules.legalInstrument: Income Tax Ordinance 2001, securities CGT regime as amended
rules.officialSource: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries — Pakistan, individual income determination (reviewed 24 Aug 2026): 'the personal income tax rates are applicable ... provided that the rate of tax shall not be less than 15%'

rules.legalInstrument: Income Tax Ordinance 2001 securities CGT regime
rules.officialSource: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries (reviewed 24 Aug 2026), graded table
rules.verificationStatus: VERIFIED — reference table only; calculator models the ≥2024-07-01 regime

rules.exactRate: 12.5% flat (irrespective of holding period); 0% for acquisitions before 2013-07-01
rules.verificationStatus: VERIFIED_STATUTORY_RATE (reference table; not modelled by the calculator)

rules.exactRate: 15% final tax (companies, mutual funds, REITs); exceptions: 7.5% IPP pass-through, 25% where paying company had no tax payable, 35% SPV dividends to other persons
rules.officialSource: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries — Pakistan, individual income determination (reviewed 24 Aug 2026)

rules.rule: Dividend WHT — resident but INACTIVE taxpayer (non-filer)
rules.exactRate: 15% × 2 = 30% (rates increased by 100% for resident inactive recipients)
rules.officialSource: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries (reviewed 24 Aug 2026): 'The WHT rates shall increase by 100% in case recipient of dividend is a resident but inactive taxpayer'

rules.exactRate: carry-forward against future securities capital gains for up to 3 tax years (from tax year 2019 onward)
rules.verificationStatus: VERIFIED — the aggregated calculator reports lossCarriedForward as a data point only

unverified_items.item: None of the rates above remain unverified as of 2026-11-05.
unverified_items.label: No UNKNOWN rates remain. The non-filer CGT calculator OUTPUT remains VERIFIED_RULE_PROVISIONAL_IMPLEMENTATION by design (slab dependence); UI shows the provisional warning via isRateUnverified().

unverified_items.item: SECP/NCCPL regulator-fee components and broker-specific charges are outside this schedule (calculator models commission only).
unverified_items.label: UNVERIFIED — DO NOT USE AS FINAL TAX ADVICE (explicitly out of scope, not displayed as a tax rate)

shariah_information.implementation: Optional beta profile preference (shariahScreen); exposure limited to noting whether the optional screening preference is on and to provider-listed Islamic indices (e.g. KMI30) in the indices API.
shariah_information.sourceUsed: Provider index list (api.askanalyst.com.pk indices incl. KMI30) — methodology and as-of date are the provider's; no independent compliance verification performed.
safeguards: Screening is OPTIONAL (user checkbox with explicit disclosure).
The system never infers the user's religion.
No universal Shariah-compliance claim is made anywhere in the beta UI; the onboarding disclosure states the screening uses a stated methodology with a source as-of date and makes no compliance claim.
No claim that any listed security is 'Shariah compliant' is generated by Latent.pk.
shariah_information.verificationStatus: VERIFIED_AS_LIMITED (optional preference + provider-listed index; no compliance claims) — an authoritative per-security compliance list (e.g. a current SECP/Meezan research desk list) would be required before any deeper claim; none is made.

presentation_guarantees: Calculators show the schedule id, verification status and the standing disclaimer 'Illustrative estimate only — not professional tax advice'.
Non-filer CGT output keeps an explicit provisional warning in the UI (isRateUnverified() returns true).
No tax or Shariah module output is presented as professional advice anywhere in the beta.
task118_consistency_note: Task 118 Part H: verification states restated with the precise vocabulary VERIFIED_STATUTORY_RATE / VERIFIED_RULE_PROVISIONAL_IMPLEMENTATION / UNVERIFIED. The earlier phrasing 'no rate remains unverified' meant no UNKNOWN rates remain; it never meant the calculator is fully verified — the non-filer CGT output remains PROVISIONAL because the verified rule is slab-based and the calculator implements only the 15% floor. The CgtCalculator UI label (previously stale Task 116 text referencing a '30% estimate') was corrected to state the floor applied and the slab dependence.
